Please check file existence and permissions."`. ,Path resolution, existence, caching, and security utilities: - `src/utils/storyReferenceUtils.ts` (heavily annotated with this story): - `buildStoryCandidates(storyPath, cwd, storyDirs)`: - For `./` or `../` paths: resolves only against `cwd`. - For bare paths: resolves `cwd + storyPath` and additional candidates under each configured `storyDirectories`. - Satisfies **REQ-PATH-RESOLUTION** and **REQ-CONFIGURABLE-PATHS**. - Caching & existence: - `fileExistStatusCache: Map` caches results (**REQ-PERFORMANCE-OPTIMIZATION**). - `checkSingleCandidate` wraps `fs.existsSync`/`fs.statSync` in try/catch; never throws, returns `status: 'exists' | 'missing' | 'fs-error'` (**REQ-FILE-EXISTENCE**, **REQ-ERROR-HANDLING**). - `getStoryExistence(candidates)` aggregates, preferring first `exists`, otherwise first `fs-error`, otherwise `missing` (**REQ-FILE-EXISTENCE**, **REQ-ERROR-HANDLING**). - `storyExists(paths: string[])` → boolean wrapper, keeping backward compatibility. - `normalizeStoryPath(storyPath, cwd, storyDirs)` → `{ candidates, exists, existence }` combines candidate building, existence check, and boolean summary. - Security and boundaries: - `enforceProjectBoundary(candidate, cwd)` returns `{ candidate, isWithinProject }` by comparing normalized absolute paths (**REQ-PROJECT-BOUNDARY**). - `isAbsolutePath`, `containsPathTraversal`, `isTraversalUnsafe`, `hasValidExtension`, `isUnsafeStoryPath` implement **REQ-SECURITY-VALIDATION** and extension checks.

`handleProjectBoundaryForExistence`: - If all candidates are out-of-project, reports `invalidPath` via injected `reportInvalidPath` and short-circuits. - Also checks `existenceResult.matchedPath` for crossing project boundary and reports `invalidPath` if outside. - traceability.notes: All acceptance criteria and technical requirements from docs/stories/006.0-DEV-FILE-VALIDATION.story.md are implemented and verified: - Core validation ensures @story paths point to existing `.story.md` files, with clear, path-specific diagnostics for missing files, invalid extensions, invalid paths, and filesystem errors. - Path resolution uses `context.cwd` (with `process.cwd` fallback), considers configured `storyDirectories`, supports both relative and absolute (optionally) paths, and enforces project boundaries through `enforceProjectBoundary` and helper logic. - Security validations prevent path traversal and disallow absolute paths unless explicitly configured, and still apply boundary checks even when allowed. - Filesystem operations are wrapped in robust utilities with caching, returning structured statuses instead of throwing; tests simulate permission and I/O errors and confirm graceful behavior and correct diagnostics. - Configuration options (`storyDirectories`, `allowAbsolutePaths`, `requireStoryExtension`) are fully wired into the rule and tested, meeting REQ-CONFIGURABLE-PATHS. - Documentation in docs/rules/valid-story-reference.md describes path resolution, boundary semantics, options, and examples consistent with the story specification. Given the passing targeted tests and the direct traceability from requirements to implementation and tests, this story is fully implemented and passes.
